content.comment_body: I'm starting a new project on my Mac, but after updating to Sonoma, my current version isn't working. Is there a new version of [product_name] for Mac, and if so, where can I download it? Thanks, [user_name]

There's no separate upgrade specifically for Mac. The latest [product_name] version is [version_no]. You can download the update by following the installation instructions for [product_name] upgrade [version_no].

Check your Java Runtime Environment, as it might need updating. Most volunteers here use PCs, so a Mac user's response might take time. You might also consider reaching out to [company_name] through the 'Support Request' link.

I had [product_name] [version_no] working well on my old Mac. After switching to a Mac with M1 chip and Sonoma OS, neither the original installation CD nor the newer version runs. Is there a way to resolve this, or suggestions for installation?

To [user_name]: Thank you! Updating the Java Runtime Environment on MacOS is the correct step for installing [product_name] on MacOS Sonoma. Update: The installer launches, but the progress remains stuck at 0%.
It might be related to permissions, though that's just a guess. Try using the Support Request link to speak to [company_name] directly. Please update us if you find a solution.
Update: I'm attempting to install [product_name] [version_no]. The installation runs on my M1 Mac with MacOS Sonoma using the Java app, but the progress sticks at 0%.
Have you contacted [company_name] yet? Forum volunteers are unlikely to have a solution in this case.
I suspect [company_name] support will respond that MacOS Sonoma isn't officially supported for [product_name], but I'll follow up with them anyway.
[company_name] hasn't tested [product_name] [version_no] with your operating system.
This thread helped me solve my issue, and I was able to install the [product_name] [version_no] update on MacOS Sonoma. (Thanks to [user_name] and [user_name])

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing compatibility problems installing [product_name] on newer Mac systems with M1 chips and MacOS Sonoma. Installations frequently stall or fail to launch, making updates challenging. The primary issue is unclear support and limited testing for MacOS Sonoma, leaving users unsure about official compatibility and potential solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to function smoothly or be quickly updated to work with MacOS Sonoma and new M1 chip hardware. Clear guidance and official compatibility for Mac devices are anticipated.
